Sobre a vaga

Company Description

Alana AI is a pioneering leader in Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing (NLP) based in Latin America, driving innovation in how brands connect with their customers. With a proven track record, including US$3M in sales, we have redefined the way conversations are transformed into meaningful experiences. As we transition into an exciting new chapter, we are committed to creating smarter, more human-centric solutions to shape the future of customer engagement.

Role Description

As a Senior Software Engineer at Alana AI, you will take ownership of designing, developing, and deploying high-quality software solutions. This fully remote, full-time role involves creating efficient back-end systems, writing and reviewing code, implementing tested and scalable features, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative projects. You will also play a key role in ensuring best practices in software development and mentoring junior engineers.

Qualifications
  • Strong foundation in Computer Science and Software Development principles
  • Proficiency in Back-End Development, including experience with programming languages and frameworks
  • Expertise in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Experience in working with scalable, cloud-based infrastructures is a plus
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
